For businesses

All roads lead to Coimbatore

An ideal destination for sustainable growth

Buy, sell, manufacture, collaborate, source – the needs could be varied, the destination is one – Coimbatore

A city that eats, sleeps and breathes enterprise – one where every fourth citizen is self-employed. Why? Because it offers an ecosystem and environment that provides you with all the right ingredients to do business, locally and globally

Reasons why the city is your ideal business destination

Business perspective

Culture perspective

Employee perspective

Comprehensive ecosystem

The city provides an all encompassing ecosystem that fosters all kinds of businesses. A growth along with everyone attitude ensures that new ventures and entrepreneurs/businessmen are welcome with open arms.

Enabling infrastructure

The enterprising nature of the city has ensured that businesses have an ideal infrastructure for rapid growth. Be it roads, logistics, are ancillary units. The city has everything that you would need for your next phase of growth.

Abundant talent pool

400+ academic institutions provide you with a pool of talent that is highly qualified as well as intrapreneurial in nature. Over 70% of this talent pool is polyglot and highly proficient in English.

Get it done attitude

When the people of Coimbatore face challenges they do not talk about excuses. Rather, they find solutions. This attitude has been ingrained for over 100 years.

Principle way of business

Hardworking ethos and a deep spiritual kind of working style mixed coimbatorians your ideal partner. This is a city that puts principles before profits.

Problem-solving thought process

An innovative and entrepreneurial mindset is all pervasive in the population of the city. This stems from historically having tenaciously faced and solved geographical, technical and administrative charges.

Social infrastructure

The presence of a comprehensive social support system which includes 300+ hospitals, 3000+ schools, old age homes and numerous service organisations enables a solid social infrastructure.

Cosmopolitan populace

A multi-cultural and multi-religious population combined with a diverse demography gives the city its cosmopolitan nature. An eagerness to lead the future ensures that the city is at the forefront of all kinds of development.

Great living conditions

Comfortable weather perennially, physical infrastructure, solid social infrastructure and the ever hospitable Kongu culture makes the city a wonderful place to live. It has always been one of the most peace loving cities in the region.
